time_to_evidence: same snapshot reprocess; live GSC currentness stays BLOCKED without credentials
principle: A candidate record is a proposal, not an INDEX grant. Page count and keyword combinations never authorize an asset. UNKNOWN demand stays UNKNOWN.
privacy_note: GSC dimensional tables are independently aggregated and privacy-thresholded. Page/query/device/country/date totals are not force-reconciled. A missing query×page matrix is join_unavailable, not a fabricated join.
question_class_source: Search-intent classes plus conversion question_class values from intent-action-matrix/1.0 (market_learning, contract_understanding, company_self_view, contract_review, operational_urgency, not_ready). Conversion routes themselves stay on WEB-003/#88 when that contract lands; this engine only labels demand.

costs.CANDIDATE: medium — human review of unique utility before any URL work
costs.DEFER: low — wait for join, data readiness or observed demand

expected_evidence.CANDIDATE: Same-snapshot reprocess (stable ranking/reasons); unique visitor utility; provenance/freshness; individual approval before INDEX. Demand stays UNKNOWN when unobserved.
expected_evidence.REJECT: Reason codes that name volume, combination or missing join. Do not reopen without new evidence.
expected_evidence.DEFER: query×page join, extra-cli public-read, or observed GSC demand — whichever the reason codes name.

kill_gates.default: Kill if the only justification is keyword volume, page count or a dimensional combination.
kill_gates.keyword_combination_does_not_authorize_p: Kill (already rejected): combinations never authorize a URL.
kill_gates.striking_distance: Kill if impressions are zero, position is outside 4–20, or the proposed fix is a new doorway page.
kill_gates.cannibalization: Kill if the clash was inferred without a query×page join.
kill_gates.wrong_landing: Kill if the landing mismatch was inferred without a query×page join.
kill_gates.query_without_useful_page: Kill if the gap is used to mint a page without singular utility and data readiness.
kill_gates.join_unavailable: Do not fabricate a join. Kill any downstream publish that treated UI CSV dimensions as a matrix.
kill_gates.demand_UNKNOWN: Kill if UNKNOWN is coerced to 0, 0.15 or any numeric stand-in.
